name: Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited
about: Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited engages in manufacturing and dealing with auto parts and engine parts for use in diesel and automobile engines in India. Its product portfolio includes pistons, piston pins, piston rings, engine bearings and bushes, air-cooled blocks, ball bearings, crank shafts, connecting rods, cylinder kits, cylinder liners and sleeves, engine valves, spring retainers, valve collets, cylinder heads, synchroniser rings, oil seals, gaskets, sealings, o' rings, and valve guides. The company serves trucks, cars, tractors, earth moving equipments, marine engines, agricultural engines, scooters, motorcycles, mopeds, three wheelers industries .Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited also exports its products. Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited was founded in 1970 and is based in Agra, India.
